I recorded the landlord's charge-free-only authority, asked the provider to confirm the date and warranty basis, asked the landlord how to proceed, updated the tenant and put the job on hold until 23 May. No human decision is needed yet.

answers.answer: Email to Harbour Services to confirm the date and warranty basis; email to the landlord asking for a decision; email to the tenant with an update. All sent.

answers.answer: Not yet. The landlord must decide on chargeable work, and that is a routine ask. Escalate if they stay silent beyond the review date.
